rows.title: Community price history is sparse and not licensed
rows.issue: Weeks 1-9 had kicked off before the first observation, so those prices are post-hoc and cannot define opening or closing lines. The current research ledger records 13 captures, with 78 of 816 event-market cells having a pre-kickoff observation and 52 marked as moved. These are community inputs; they do not satisfy the separate licensed-price policy or establish CLV.
rows.resolve: Obtain a permitted timestamped source and maintain an opening-to-close series for every originated market before publishing price-dependent performance.

rows.title: Two clubs publish no parseable depth chart
rows.issue: 30 of 32 clubs yielded depth rows. The Packers prepend jersey numbers to names and the Texans publish the chart as an image. Both are recorded as failures rather than transcribed by eye.
rows.resolve: An authorised structured export per club, or a documented decision to accept the gap.

rows.title: Only one official inactive-list read is archived
rows.issue: The dated 2026-11-16 Week 10 capture includes one NFL inactive article with 147 entries across 24 clubs. That single read does not establish a multi-week history or confirm snap participation for every player.
rows.resolve: Retain dated inactive evidence for every game and join it to official game books or snap evidence without inference.
rows.source_label: NFL Week 10 inactive list (OFFICIAL); archive capture: injury-archive/data/index.jsonl

rows.title: The personnel ablation cannot resolve an effect
rows.issue: At the published λ=1.0 setting, the Week 7-10 holdout MAE improvement is +0.040 points with interval [-0.185, +0.102]. The interval includes zero; this sample does not establish an injury effect.
rows.resolve: More pre-kickoff games and dated availability captures before re-testing.

rows.title: Team-code aliases differ between sources
rows.issue: nfl.com's 2026 standings publish AZ for Arizona; the community schedule publishes ARI. Los Angeles is LA on both. The feed maps the alias explicitly and the reconciliation would fail if it did not.
rows.resolve: Keep the explicit alias map and assert it in tests; do not normalise silently.

rows.title: Kickoff times carry no time zone
rows.issue: The schedule publishes kickoff in US Eastern but the field has no zone. The price store converts at a fixed UTC-4, which is up to 60 minutes wrong once Eastern Standard Time begins.
rows.resolve: Capture an explicit UTC kickoff, or store the observation as 'pre-kickoff by minutes' instead of a boolean.

rows.title: Retrospective diagnostics include demoted strategies
rows.issue: The current G10 artifact demotes 3 rules (S01, S02, S03) whose Brier-skill upper interval is below zero. These remain historical diagnostics, not prospective leaderboard entries; a new registration is required before any future evaluation.
rows.resolve: Require a new registration hash before a demoted rule can return.

rows.title: No reward pool, rule set or funding source exists
rows.issue: The brief asks for a leaderboard competition with rewards for top performers. No funding source, jurisdiction or payout rule exists, so no reward is described as available.
rows.resolve: Decide jurisdiction and funding before any reward is announced.

rows.title: A historical no-injury section is not a current availability statement
rows.issue: The 2026-11-12 snapshot had 4 clubs without an injury section; the later 2026-11-16 Week 10 read records zero such sections. These are distinct dated observations. An absent section must never be interpreted as 'available'.
rows.resolve: Keep both dated observations and compare each club with the next report and inactive evidence.
rows.source_label: NFL Week 10 injury report (OFFICIAL); later read: matchup capture 2026-11-16

rows.title: Correlation C02 mixes a community price with an official score
rows.issue: It is published for transparency and excluded from every official-only gate. A reader who skims the table could mistake it for an official-input correlation.
rows.resolve: Keep the source-class badges on the row and the note in the caption.

rows.title: Injury-report rows do not all join to a depth slot
rows.issue: The 2026-11-12 snapshot joined 185 of 254 report rows to a captured club depth slot; 69 did not join. This is a dated join result, not a claim about the later Week 10 injury capture. A player can be on the report without appearing on the captured club chart.
rows.resolve: Publish matched and unmatched counts with the snapshot date and reason for every unmatched row.

rows.title: The site's own model trails the market it compares against
rows.issue: The ridge side model's MAE is worse than the stored market spread's on the same games. It is published as a benchmark, and no strategy above it claims otherwise.
rows.resolve: Nothing to fix; it is the honest baseline. Any future model must beat this before claiming skill.
